args:
test "$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' gcc)" = "4:12.2.0-3"   && test "$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' make)" = "4.3-4.1"   && test "$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' gnupg)" = "2.2.40-1.1+deb12u2"   && test "$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' libcurl4-openssl-dev)" = "7.88.1-10+deb12u15"   && test "$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' libexpat1-dev)" = "2.5.0-1+deb12u2"   && test "$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' libssl-dev)" = "3.0.20-1~deb12u2"   && test "$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' xz-utils)" = "5.4.1-1+deb12u1"   && test "$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' zlib1g-dev)" = "1:1.2.13.dfsg-1"   && test "$(sha256sum /tmp/git.tar.xz | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "${GIT_SOURCE_SHA256}"   && test "$(sha256sum /tmp/git.tar.sign | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "${GIT_SIGNATURE_SHA256}"   && test "$(sha256sum /tmp/release-key.asc | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "${RELEASE_KEY_SHA256}"   && mkdir -m 0700 /tmp/gnupg   && gpg --homedir /tmp/gnupg --import /tmp/release-key.asc   && gpg --homedir /tmp/gnupg --with-colons --fingerprint     | grep -Fqx "fpr:::::::::${RELEASE_KEY_FINGERPRINT}:"   && xz -dc /tmp/git.tar.xz > /tmp/git.tar   && gpg --homedir /tmp/gnupg --verify /tmp/git.tar.sign /tmp/git.tar   && mkdir /tmp/git-source   && tar -xf /tmp/git.tar --strip-components=1 -C /tmp/git-source   && cd /tmp/git-source   && test "$(./GIT-VERSION-GEN . --format=@GIT_VERSION@)" = "${GIT_VERSION}"   && grep -q 'NO_TCLTK' Makefile   && grep -q 'NO_GETTEXT' Makefile   && grep -q 'NO_RUST' Makefile   && make -j2 prefix=/opt/conexus/git-${GIT_VERSION} all NO_TCLTK=YesPlease NO_GETTEXT=YesPlease NO_RUST=YesPlease   && make prefix=/opt/conexus/git-${GIT_VERSION} install NO_TCLTK=YesPlease NO_GETTEXT=YesPlease NO_RUST=YesPlease   && mkdir -p /opt/conexus/git-${GIT_VERSION}/share/conexus   && printf 'NO_TCLTK=YesPlease
NO_GETTEXT=YesPlease
NO_RUST=YesPlease
' > /opt/conexus/git-${GIT_VERSION}/share/conexus/build-flags   && test ! -e /opt/conexus/git-${GIT_VERSION}/bin/gitk   && test ! -e /opt/conexus/git-${GIT_VERSION}/bin/git-gui   && test ! -d /opt/conexus/git-${GIT_VERSION}/share/locale   && rm -rf /tmp/git-source /tmp/git.tar /tmp/gnupg
